name: Whitegloveai Highered
description: Free, open-source Claude Skills purpose-built for higher education institutional operations. 87 skills across 14 plugins covering board of regents, president and cabinet, admissions and enrollment, financial aid, academic affairs, student affairs, research compliance, finance and business, athletics compliance, HR and faculty, communications and marketing, IT and information security, accreditation, and advancement. FERPA-aware, Title IV precision, Common Rule compliant. NIST AI RMF aligned. MIT licensed.
longDescription:
Installs with `claude plugin install whitegloveai-highered@claude-community` from `whitegloveai/claude-skills-highered`.

87 skills across 14 plugins covering community colleges, four-year universities, and research universities — both public and private. Federal-first regulatory framing with multi-accreditor and multi-state overlay throughout. The largest library in the WhitegloveAI Skills series.
